summary: Frontend-only validation of CRM-only Connect Pro Zelix changes. Logged in as admin@educonnect.app and verified: (1) Overview page shows CRM overview block with office switcher (all/KM_BLR/KM_TCR/KM_KMLY), old crm-kpis testid removed. (2) Sidebar renamed Contacts->Employees; Customize nav-branding removed; all expected items present (nav-overview, nav-leads, nav-clients=Employees, nav-messages, nav-users=Team, nav-activity, nav-settings). (3) /clients renders Employees directory (title 'Employees', 'Staff & KM office accounts.', 'Add employee' button, empty state 'No employees yet'). (4) /leads shows tabs crm-tab-all + crm-tab-campaigns; crm-tab-overview removed; crm-all-leads default. (5) Team Create user dialog: default role 'User (linked to an employee)', cu-linked-client picker present; switching to Office Admin shows cu-name text input and hides picker. (6) Settings has change-password-card (cp-current/new/confirm/submit), settings-customize-section with branding-form; pin-settings-card removed. (7) Change password wrong current -> toast 'Current password is incorrect' shown; admin/owner passwords NOT changed. All 35 structural checks passed.

If product intent was to fully drop KPI tiles/funnel from Dashboard, CrmAnalytics needs trimming. Structural test (crm-kpis testid absent) passes.
